d.s: A concentrated tile adhesive additive designed to increase flexibility, strength and water resistance of cement-based products.
a: Increases flexibility, strength and water resistance of cement based tile adhesives
Ideal for submerged, façade and high foot traffic tiling applications
Use when tiling over existing tiles
us: Suitable for interior and exterior applications. Davco Davelastic being an acrylic polymer creates water resistance in mortars, which enables them to be used in wet areas including concrete swimming pools, spas and external façades.
d.pk: Available in a 1Ltr or 5Ltr jerry cans or a 20L pail

sec.t: Tile adhesive | Davelastic | Water | Classification Davco SMP EVO (C2TES1) | 2.5Ltrs | 2.5Ltrs | C2TS2
12 months from date of manufacturer if unopened.
Store in dry cool conditions our of direct sunlight.

Davelastic must be diluted with clean, potable water at a ratio of 1 to 1 for use as an additive in cement based tile adhesives. Thoroughly mix the required amount of Davelastic and water together prior to mixing with the adhesive.

All surfaces must be installed according to manufacturer’s instructions and relevant Australian Standard(s) and be structurally sound, dry, clean and free from movement, oil, grease, wax, sealers, curing compounds, release agents and any other loose or contaminating material. Thoroughly clean old surfaces, or new surfaces that have been treated, prior to tiling Deeply contaminated surfaces must be scabbled / abraded to a clean, sound surface; Expose at least 80% of the original substrate of painted surfaces Surfaces should be prepared and primed in accordance to the relevant tile adhesive product datasheet

Tile Adhesive Mix Process Add the required amount of Davco Davelastic and water mixture into a clean bucket. Slowly add the powder to the liquid while mixing with a mixing paddle attached to a drill. Always add the powder to the liquid. Do not mix by hand. + Continue to mix for several minutes until a creamy consistency is achieved, free of lumps of powder. Allow mixture to stand for 5 minutes, remix then use the adhesive. The tile adhesive should be applied as per the instructions for the adhesive, including all surface preparation Note: Davco Davelastic will increase the tackiness of the adhesive as well as reduce the pot life, open time and adjustment time.
Tools and equipement can be cleaned prior to setting.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: No special measures required. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.
